evals.prompt: 이 작업 코덱스에 시켜줘. Ask Codex to review the auth diff and leave a record of which model ran.
evals.expected_output: States the done predicate and the return, probes authenticated CLIs, writes a plan whose rationale names the Codex route and the quota evidence, runs from a prompt file with the diff passed as a context file, then reads meta.json and result.md itself and shows the report with the call tree.
assertions: The done predicate and the single return are stated before probe runs.
Probe with --check-auth completes before a route is chosen.
The diff is passed with --context-file and is not pasted into the prompt.
The final report shows the worker's PASS, ISSUES, or BLOCKED verdict and the call tree from report.md.

evals.prompt: 다른 모델로 한 번 더 확인해줘. Only Claude Code is installed and authenticated, and I did not name a model.
evals.expected_output: Reports that the machine is not heterogeneous and does the check in the current session without spawning a CLI.
assertions: Does not call run when probe reports heterogeneous false and the user named no agent or model.
Tells the user the work stayed in this session because only one usable route exists.

evals.prompt: Build this whole project end to end and keep going until it is done. Use subagents in worktrees.
evals.expected_output: Does not run swarm and uses long-task, because the request is a multi-milestone autonomous project rather than one fan-out.
assertions: Does not probe CLIs or write a swarm plan for this request.

evals.prompt: Race the same read-only review of the auth diff on two model vendors, then poll every few seconds until result.md appears.
evals.expected_output: Frames a race, declares its selection rule before spawning, plans two arms on different vendors, and waits on the process timeout or the host completion notice. It does not sleep-poll for the result file.
assertions: The race selection rule (first pass, rank all, or best of) is declared before any arm runs.
The plan is rejected if both arms use the same vendor.
The run does not use a sleep loop to wait for result.md.

evals.prompt: 병렬로 나눠서 돌려줘. Split the lint fixes across the api/ and web/ packages with subagents. The web worker came back without saying whether the build passed.
evals.expected_output: Partitions the work into two disjoint write sets, reruns the web worker once because its result omitted the required verification, and records a gap if it misses again instead of counting it as a pass.
assertions: The two slices have disjoint write sets.
The incomplete web result is rerun once before it is recorded as a gap.
The report does not count the gap as PASS and the done predicate is not VERIFIED.

evals.prompt: 후보 여러 개 경쟁시켜줘. Give me three attempts at the config loader API and keep the best design.
evals.expected_output: Selects arena, because the user wants competing attempts at one artifact with one winner grafted together, not slices of one job.
assertions: Does not write a partition plan for the three attempts.
